label: Alexa TTS (optional)
info:
OPTIONAL add-on. Requires the palette:

    node-red-contrib-alexa-remote2

Install it via Menu -> Manage palette -> Install, then open the
'speak on Echo' node and create/select an Alexa account config node
(the account cannot be pre-filled here -- it holds a login and is
created interactively in the editor).

Wiring: Alexa Routine -> turns on a virtual device / calls the
webhook -> this flow runs server_brain.py and announces the result
on the chosen Echo.

name: 1. Install node-red-contrib-alexa-remote2  2. Configure the account node  3. Pick your Echo
info:
The 'speak on Echo' node below is deliberately left without an
account reference so this file imports without leaking credentials.
Node-RED will flag it as needing configuration -- that is expected.

name: test phrase
payload: Yes, the movie is at 42 percent. About 5 minutes remaining.

name: prepare TTS text
>>> Connect 'prepare TTS text' to an alexa-remote-routine node (type: speak) <<<
info:
Add the node manually after installing the palette:

  Node: alexa-remote-routine
  Routine type: speak
  Text: msg.payload
  Device: your Echo

It is not shipped pre-wired here because an unresolved contrib node
type makes the whole flow file fail to import on a stock Node-RED.
